hooks/useConfiguratorShare.ts.name: Shareable ring build link
hooks/useConfiguratorShare.ts.description: Saves the customer's ring choices into the page address so they can copy and share a link to their exact build.

hooks/useFadeInOnScroll.ts.name: Scroll fade-in
hooks/useFadeInOnScroll.ts.description: Fades an element smoothly into view when the visitor scrolls it onto the screen.

hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.ts.name: Keyboard navigation
hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.ts.description: Lets visitors move through menus, modals, and lists using arrow keys, Tab, and Escape for full keyboard access.

hooks/useParallax.ts.name: Parallax scroll effect
hooks/useParallax.ts.description: Adds a subtle depth effect by moving an element at a different speed as the visitor scrolls.

hooks/usePerformance.ts.name: Page speed tracking
hooks/usePerformance.ts.description: Measures how fast each page loads and reports the numbers so the team can spot and fix slowdowns.

hooks/useRecentlyViewed.ts.name: Recently viewed products
hooks/useRecentlyViewed.ts.description: Remembers which products the customer looked at and shows them again for easy comparison.

hooks/useReducedMotion.ts.name: Reduced motion check
hooks/useReducedMotion.ts.description: Detects when a visitor has asked their device to limit animations and turns off motion effects to respect that choice.

hooks/useScrollReveal.ts.name: Scroll reveal animation
hooks/useScrollReveal.ts.description: Animates an element's opacity, position, or scale as it enters the screen during scrolling.

hooks/useStaggerChildren.ts.name: Staggered children reveal
hooks/useStaggerChildren.ts.description: Reveals a group of child items one by one with a short delay between each as the visitor scrolls.

hooks/useWishlist.ts.name: Wishlist
hooks/useWishlist.ts.description: Lets customers save favourite products to a wishlist and check whether a product is already saved.
